groups.operation: Read supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
groups.condition: A PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, and the harness reads to IEND.
groups.capability: Dispatch the metadata handler and reach png_decompress_chunk.
groups.consequence: The metadata decompression path may not be reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same general post-IDAT compressed metadata operation and the same unresolved path to png_decompress_chunk.

groups.operation: Continue sequential row reading with png_read_row after png_read_update_info and png_start_read_image.
groups.condition: png_read_update_info initializes row state before the harness calls png_start_read_image again.
groups.capability: Handle the duplicate initialization report through png_app_error without preventing accepted row data from being read; the effect depends on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.
groups.consequence: The duplicate-call application error may prevent row decoding.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four identify the same duplicate row initialization sequence and its possible effect on subsequent row reading.

groups.operation: Decode Adam7 rows sequentially with pass and row counts matching the harness loop.
groups.condition: For Adam7 input, the harness calls png_set_interlace_handling after png_read_update_info has initialized rows.
groups.capability: Establish interlace state before row initialization, or have png_set_interlace_handling reconcile the initialized state.
groups.consequence: Pass or row state may be inconsistent during png_read_row.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both concern the same Adam7 interlace state setup and its possible effect on sequential row counts.

groups.operation: Read compressed zTXt metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
groups.condition: A PNG contains zTXt after IDAT and the build supports compressed text reading.
groups.capability: Dispatch the zTXt handler and reach png_decompress_chunk.
groups.consequence: The zTXt decompression path may not be reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: This candidate specifies zTXt and its feature configuration; equivalence with the broader compressed ancillary metadata candidates is uncertain.
